text.description_html:
LCN 4111T Door Closer Hold Open Wheel

This is the New Style replacement Hold Open wheel for LCN 4111T Track Closer (LCN Super Smoothee) Surface Mount Track Arm Closer.

Also available other LCN Door Closer Parts

Nylon wheel assembly with Hold Open Detent Ball, internal roller bearing and thrush bearing.

*Sold Individually
